purpose: Test whether Script93 team-linked positive residuals are explained by Deadlock team comeback economy.
Measure exact team net worth at Trooper death and AssignedGold payout.
Compare whether comeback state is better explained at source death versus eventual ground-soul resolution.
Compare 25% historical and 26% current maximum comeback bonus references.
Compare plausible denominator interpretations for percentage net-worth deficit.
Determine whether comeback correction collapses the remaining ground-soul amount residuals.

semanticLimits.netWorth: Team net worth is reconstructed by summing controller m_iGoldNetWorth at the exact requested replay tick.
semanticLimits.comeback: A good match to the documented comeback formula is observational validation within test.dem, not engine-source proof.
semanticLimits.maxBonus: 25% and 26% are tested separately because historical official and current reference values differ.
semanticLimits.catchup: The separate post-laning bottom-two-player catch-up mechanic is not modeled here. The primary cohort already requires exact integer-partition ground-soul reward events, which should strongly suppress unrelated player-specific additions.
semanticLimits.anchor: Death and active=false are compared because telemetry alone should determine whether the relevant team-state snapshot is source-time or payout-time.
semanticLimits.denominator: The exact engine definition of percent net-worth deficit is not assumed; leading-team, trailing-team, and mean-team denominators are compared.

interpretationGuide.comeback: If comeback correction sharply reduces Script93 RMSE and removes the Team-3 positive residual tail, the remaining amount modifier is strongly attributable to trailing-team economy.
interpretationGuide.deathAnchor: If death-time net worth clearly outperforms payout-time net worth, the ground-soul reward magnitude is most consistent with being determined when the Trooper dies rather than when the orb is later vacuumed.
interpretationGuide.first3000: If IGNORE_FIRST_3000 outperforms the no-ignore control, the replay independently supports that documented mechanic.
interpretationGuide.maxBonus: If 25% and 26% are nearly indistinguishable, keep the exact maximum unresolved until cross-replay provides larger comeback deficits.
interpretationGuide.grid: The bonus grid is exploratory. A fitted maximum near 0.25-0.26 supports the documented magnitude but should not replace predefined validation.
interpretationGuide.next: Inspect trailing-team cases and remaining residual structure before introducing another modifier.
